- Equity is 0.02 pp from target (signed -0.02 pp, so marginally underweight). Its actual weight is 69.98% against a 70.0% target.
- Bond drifts 0.01 pp and cash 0.0 pp.
- Portfolio Drift is 0.02 pp, far inside the growth Risk Profile's warning tolerance of 4.0 pp. Every asset class shows status "ok".
